description: Starts the battle for a revealed tournament or hidden-list game with both sealed lists attached, as Start battle on its page does, and returns its token for get_my_battle and submit_battle_action. In Swiss rounds omit opponentId to play your current table; Swiss refuses anyone else. Otherwise name the opponent from get_my_event's entrants, and for a team game the ally and second opponent too. For a league fixture use create_battle with the fixture's start instead. Requires mcp:write.

allyId.description: Your ally in a 2v1 or 2v2 game.

eventToken.description: eventToken from list_my_events; only an old link needs it.

missionPackId.description: A mission pack id from list_reference; omit for the current pack, as the site does.

opponentId.description: An entrant id; omit in Swiss rounds for your paired opponent.

secondOpponentId.description: The second opposing player in a 2v1 or 2v2 game.

token.description: The tournament or hidden-list game token, from list_my_events or its invite link.

name: start_event_battle
title: Start my tournament battle
